title: promote-release.mjs hand-cut hint and --notes-from review minors (before quest latest moves)
description: Follow-up to the QCLI-515 round-2 Opus verdict (claude-opus-5-5, sha256 b141dc361c7eb36e7a5741939f63feb858a98fa0129c0d1fb4182861edda9103, verbatim on QCLI-515), Minors 1-3 and nits. Minor 1 must land BEFORE quest latest moves: the hand-cut repair hint at scripts/promote-release.mjs (~:732) lacks the host pin and does not say the notes file is the section BODY, so a hand cut that includes the ## 0.14.1 heading makes every later preflight refuse with notes differ. Not started; the orchestrator holds the word to begin.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The hand-cut hint prints: gh release create v<version> -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --verify-tag --title "Quest CLI <version>" --notes-file <the section body, without its ## heading> --latest, with a test pinning -R and the body-only wording that goes red when either is removed.

The test comment claiming the real-range fixtures are not typed by hand says projected from the API; test header line 10 no longer says CHANGELOG-only; the absent/added/removed/renamed refusal assertions check the must-be-modified text rather than the bare CHANGELOG.md string; the promote-release.mjs log line no longer splits tag commit from its sha.
